'''Cazne''' was a region of barren flatlands, located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], it was the location of a massacre of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and housed numerous craters. It was also the hideout of the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]].
